name: start-coffee-chat-prep
description: Prepares a Coffee Chat Plan for a call someone agreed to, with what you know about their work and its sources, three questions you want answered, one useful thing to offer, what you will not pitch and how you would close. Use for "run start-coffee-chat-prep", "prep me for this coffee chat", "I have a catch-up with a former colleague tomorrow", "I do not want this to feel like a sales call", "what should I ask", "plan my intro call", "help me prepare a catch-up", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
